faqs.a:
In addition to all of the other powers conferred upon it by
sections 46-43
—
46-46
, the authority may do all things necessary and convenient to carry out the powers
               expressly given in this article. No provisions with respect to the acquisition, operation
               or disposition of property by public bodies shall be applicable to the authority unless
               the legislature specifically so states.
(Code 1981, § 14-16; Ord. No. 1248, § 7(3), 6-16-1975)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 29-4-209(3).
